# 127. AI-frossa, kunglig glans och Investors 110-årskalas

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-10-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts open on AI-bubble worries: Gartner's warning about neocloud providers, the KOSPI falling 18% in a week, wider CoreWeave credit spreads and a Bank of America survey showing managers fear an AI bubble yet are heavily overweight tech. They contrast a 'K-shaped' market, where AI and semiconductor names (ASML, TSMC, AQ Group) thrive while the real economy (Dustin) weakens. Company talk centres on AQ Group's strong data-centre-driven report, SEB's sell-off after the FI capital-requirement news and Johan Torgeby's exit, Investor's 110th anniversary and long record of beating the index, the SBB D-share drama, and property stocks being widely disliked as a possible contrarian idea.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AQ — AQ Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Fantastic report driven by data-centre and defence demand; CEO praised for turning a low-margin business into a high-margin one.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts praise AQ Group's latest report, driven by data-centre component demand, and CEO James Ahlgren's skill at targeting hot areas (defence, data centres) and refusing low margins. When asked whether he would sell AQ if Ahlgren left, the host stressed Ahlgren's star quality, which suggests the thesis depends on him. No explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if James Ahlgren leaves for a larger role (e.g. Nibe, Sandvik)
- if data-centre or defence demand slows
- if margins fall back to industry-low levels

> *"James Ahlgren presenterade en fantastisk rapport från AQ-gruppen. Och det var ju också drivet av Datacenter."*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Has beaten the index 15 straight years and is on track for a 16th; strong leadership recruitment; up 1,749% over 20 years.

#### Reasoning

Hosts celebrate the 110th anniversary and Investor's record of beating the index 15 years running, on track for a 16th. They credit the Wallenbergs' focus on recruiting and keeping the right leaders, and say the discount has narrowed sharply since its 35% days. Nepotism in appointments is named as the main risk to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if nepotism starts to drive appointments in the sphere
- if it stops beating the index
- if key holdings' leadership deteriorates

> *"Ingenting tyder på det idag, och det är positivt. Men vi ska ju hålla ögonen på det."*

---

### 🟠 SEB-A — SEB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Down about 7% after the CEO exit and FI capital-requirement news; host calls it an overreaction since it is a model change, not a credit loss.

#### Reasoning

Host argues the FI change affects capital calculation and is not a credit loss, so a few percent drop would have been reasonable rather than 4-5% in a day. He hedges, saying he may have to eat his words. Extra dividends and buybacks may be toned down, and a new CEO adds uncertainty.

#### Sell Triggers

- if extra dividends or buybacks are cancelled
- if more FI sanctions follow
- if the new CEO choice disappoints

> *"Om någonting så skulle jag säga att det var lite av en överreaktion på marknaden."*

---

### 🟠 DUST — Dustin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sales down 5%, blamed on customers ordering earlier to beat price rises; share fell sharply.

#### Reasoning

Dustin is used as the example of the weak real economy in the K-shaped market. One host found it interesting that customers pulled orders forward on inflation expectations, so the weakness may partly be timing. This is speculative, not a recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the sales decline continues next quarter
- if the pull-forward explanation proves wrong

> *"Den gick ju ner rätt mycket på rapporten för att försäljningen var ner 5 procent."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Corporate bond risk premiums have spiked; described as a high-risk data-centre player and an AI-bubble warning sign.

#### Reasoning

Host Mellqvist, who leans bearish on AI, points to CoreWeave's widening credit spreads as an alarm bell, together with Gartner's warning that 80% of neocloud providers could fail.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit spreads tighten again
- if neocloud business models prove profitable

> *"Coreweave har jag nämnt förut i podden. Vi har sett sina riskpremier på kreditsidan, på företagsobligationssidan sticka i höjden."*

---
